title: Enforcement Decree of the Korea Maritime Transportation Safety Authority Act
full_text:
ENFORCEMENT DECREE OF THE KOREA MARITIME TRANSPORTATION SAFETY AUTHORITY ACT

Article 1 (Purpose)
The purpose of this Decree is to prescribe matters delegated by the Korea Maritime Transportation Safety Authority Act and matters necessary for the enforcement thereof.

Article 2 (Registration of Establishment)
The following matters shall be registered when registering the establishment of the Korea Maritime Transportation Safety Authority (hereinafter referred to as the "Authority") under Article 4 of the Korea Maritime Transportation Safety Authority Act (hereinafter referred to as the "Act"):
1. Objectives;
2. Name;
3. Locations of its principal office, branches, business offices, research institutes, educational institutes, etc.;
4. Names and addresses of its officers;
5. Method of public announcement.

Article 3 (Registration of Establishment of Branches, etc.)
Where the Authority establishes a branch, business office, research institute, educational institute, or other establishment not belonging to the principal office pursuant to Article 3 (2) of the Act (hereinafter referred to as a "branch, etc."), it shall register the name, location, and date of establishment of the branch, etc. at the location of its principal office within three weeks after establishment.

Article 4 (Registration of Relocation)
(1) Where the Authority relocates its principal office, it shall register its new location and the date of relocation at its former or new location within three weeks after relocation.
(2) Where the Authority relocates a branch, etc., it shall register the new location and the date of relocation at the location of its principal office within three weeks after relocation.

Article 5 (Registration of Changes)
Where any registered matter referred to in the subparagraphs of Article 2 or Article 3 is changed (excluding a relocation subject to registration under Article 4), the Authority shall register the change at the location of its principal office within three weeks after the change.

Article 6 (Documents for Applications for Registration)
An application for registration under Articles 2 through 5 shall be accompanied by the following documents, as applicable:
1. Registration of establishment under Article 2: The relevant articles of incorporation;
2. Registration of establishment of a branch, etc. under Article 3: Documents evidencing the establishment of the branch, etc.;
3. Registration of relocation under Article 4: Documents evidencing the relocation of the principal office or branch, etc.;
4. Registration of changes under Article 5: Documents evidencing the changes.

Article 7 (Advisory Bodies)
(1) Pursuant to Article 6 (2) of the Act, the chairperson of the Authority shall commission as advisory committee members persons with substantial knowledge and experience in fields such as maritime transportation safety, ship inspection, and management of safe passenger ship operations.
(2) The term of office of an advisory committee member under paragraph (1) shall be one year.
(3) The Authority may seek advice from its advisory body regarding the following matters:
1. Specialized or technical matters concerning performance of the Authority's projects under Article 9 of the Act;
2. Matters concerning formulation and implementation of business plans and proposed budgets under Article 14 of the Act;
3. Other matters deemed necessary by the chairperson of the Authority in connection with the operation of the Authority.

Article 8 (Payment of Government Contributions)
(1) Where the Government intends to pay contributions to the Authority under Article 10, subparagraph 1, of the Act, the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries shall include the contributions in the budget and pay them.
(2) In order to receive contributions under paragraph (1), the Authority shall submit an application for payment to the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries, accompanied by a business plan and a budget implementation plan.

Article 9 (Contributions from Persons Other Than the Government)
(1) The method of making contributions under Article 10, subparagraph 1, of the Act by persons other than the Government may be determined through consultation between the person intending to make the contribution and the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries.
(2) The Minister of Oceans and Fisheries may request the heads of relevant ministries to cooperate in obtaining contributions from persons other than the Government under paragraph (1).

Article 10 (Subsidies)
In order to receive a subsidy pursuant to Article 10, subparagraph 1, of the Act, the Authority shall submit an application for the subsidy to the head of the agency granting the subsidy, accompanied by a business plan and a budget implementation plan.

Article 11 (Borrowing Funds, etc.)
(1) In order to borrow funds or import materials pursuant to Article 12 of the Act, the Authority shall submit an application for approval to the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries, including the following:
1. Reasons for borrowing and the amount to be borrowed (or, where materials are to be imported, their type, quantity, and price);
2. Institution from which the funds are to be borrowed or materials imported;
3. Conditions for borrowing funds or importing materials;
4. Method and period for repaying borrowed funds or materials to be imported;
5. Other matters necessary for borrowing funds, importing materials, and repayment thereof.
(2) Where an application for approval under paragraph (1) relates to borrowing funds from abroad or importing materials from abroad, the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries shall consult with the Minister of Finance and Economy and the Minister of Planning and Budget before granting approval. <Amended on Dec. 30, 2025>

ADDENDA <Presidential Decree No. 29849, June 11, 2019>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
This Decree shall enter into force on July 1, 2019.

Article 2 (Amendment of Other Statutes and Regulations)
(1) Part of the Enforcement Decree of the Act on the Development and Management of Marinas shall be amended as follows:
In Article 35 (2), "Korea Ship Safety Technology Authority under Article 45 of the Ship Safety Act" shall be replaced with "Korea Maritime Transportation Safety Authority established under the Korea Maritime Transportation Safety Authority Act".

(2) Part of the Enforcement Decree of the Ship Investment Company Act shall be amended as follows:
Article 15, subparagraph 1, shall be amended as follows:
1. The Korea Maritime Transportation Safety Authority established under the Korea Maritime Transportation Safety Authority Act and classification societies under Article 60 (2) of the Ship Safety Act.

(3) Part of the Enforcement Decree of the Fishing Vessels Act shall be amended as follows:
In the part of Article 16 (3) other than the subparagraphs thereof, "Korea Ship Safety Technology Authority established under Article 45 of the Ship Safety Act" shall be replaced with "Korea Maritime Transportation Safety Authority established under the Korea Maritime Transportation Safety Authority Act".

(4) Part of the Enforcement Decree of the Fishing Grounds Management Act shall be amended as follows:
In Note 3 of attached Table 1, "Korea Ship Safety Technology Authority" shall be replaced with "Korea Maritime Transportation Safety Authority established under the Korea Maritime Transportation Safety Authority Act".

(5) Part of the Enforcement Decree of the Framework Act on the Management of Disasters and Safety shall be amended as follows:
Item 73 of attached Table 1-2 shall be amended as follows:
73. Korea Maritime Transportation Safety Authority.

(6) Part of the Enforcement Decree of the Restriction of Special Taxation Act shall be amended as follows:
Article 106 (7) 24 shall be amended as follows:
24. The Korea Maritime Transportation Safety Authority established under the Korea Maritime Transportation Safety Authority Act.

(7) Part of the Enforcement Decree of the Framework Act on Local Taxes shall be amended as follows:
In the column of institutions required to submit taxation data for item 145 of attached Table 3, "Korea Ship Safety Technology Authority under the Ship Safety Act" shall be replaced with "Korea Maritime Transportation Safety Authority established under the Korea Maritime Transportation Safety Authority Act".

(8) Part of the Enforcement Decree of the Harbor Act shall be amended as follows:
In the part of Article 25-4 (1) other than the subparagraphs thereof and in paragraph (2) of the same Article, each reference to "Korea Ship Safety Technology Authority" shall be replaced with "Korea Maritime Transportation Safety Authority".

(9) Part of the Enforcement Decree of the Marine Environment Management Act shall be amended as follows:
In Article 88 (1), "Korea Ship Safety Technology Authority" shall be replaced with "Korea Maritime Transportation Safety Authority".

(10) Part of the Enforcement Decree of the Act on Conservation and Utilization of the Marine Environment shall be amended as follows:
Article 11 (2) 4 shall be amended as follows:
4. The Korea Maritime Transportation Safety Authority established under the Korea Maritime Transportation Safety Authority Act and classification societies under Article 60 (2) of the Ship Safety Act.

ADDENDUM TO THE PRESIDENTIAL DECREE PARTIALLY AMENDING 78 STATUTES AND REGULATIONS FOR REFORM OF CORPORATE REGISTRATION RULES <Presidential Decree No. 35228, January 21, 2025>
This Decree shall enter into force on January 31, 2025.

ADDENDA TO THE ORGANIZATION OF THE MINISTRY OF FINANCE AND ECONOMY <Presidential Decree No. 35947, December 30, 2025>
Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
This Decree shall enter into force on January 2, 2026: Provided, That amended provisions of Presidential Decrees amended under Article 6 of these Addenda which were promulgated before this Decree enters into force but whose enforcement dates have not yet arrived shall enter into force on the respective enforcement dates of those Presidential Decrees.

Articles 2 through 5
Omitted.

Article 6 (Amendment of Other Statutes and Regulations)
(1) through (270) Omitted.
(271) Part of the Enforcement Decree of the Korea Maritime Transportation Safety Authority Act shall be amended as follows:
In Article 11 (2), "Minister of Strategy and Finance" shall be replaced with "Minister of Finance and Economy and Minister of Planning and Budget".
(272) through (313) Omitted.
